title: Make view.js modularization decision
description: Design decision: split view.js into modules (requires build step decision) vs extract buildCard into composable functions (keeps single file). File is 1,443 lines, six concerns, Round 3 about to add four new behaviors. Use Crosslink /design workflow. Examine actual coupling between sections, assess what a build step would require given the ES5 IIFE constraint. Blocked by: Round 3 must not start before this decision is made.
